faq.q1: Do I need any Dutch to start?
faq.a1: Not at all. NederStart starts at A0 — designed for complete beginners who know zero Dutch.
faq.q2: What languages is NederStart available in?
faq.a2: You can learn with explanations in English or Portuguese today, with more languages coming.
faq.a3: Yes. You can start learning for free with the first lessons and basic exercises.
faq.a4: NederStart certificates recognise your progress on our platform. They are not official government or CEFR qualifications.
faq.q5: Can I learn on my phone?
faq.a5: Absolutely. NederStart is mobile-first and works great on any device.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: NederStart is a product of Henrique Digital Solutions. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy.s1Body: We collect the information you provide when you create an account (name, email, password) and data generated as you learn (progress, XP, streaks, exercise results, preferences).
privacy.s2Body: We use your data to provide the learning experience, track your progress, personalise your path, and improve the platform. We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s3Body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and optional analytics cookies to understand usage. You can decline analytics cookies at any time via the cookie banner.
privacy.s4Body: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct, export and delete your data. You can export or permanently delete your account and data at any time from your profile settings.
privacy.s5Body: For any privacy request, contact Henrique Digital Solutions through the account associated with this platform.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using NederStart, a product of Henrique Digital Solutions, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: NederStart is an online platform for learning Dutch. You agree to use it for personal, lawful learning purposes and to keep your account credentials secure.
terms.s2Body: You are responsible for the activity on your account. You may delete your account at any time from your profile settings.
terms.s3Body: Learning content is provided for educational purposes. Pronunciation aids are approximations to support beginners and are not a substitute for native Dutch. Certificates recognise progress on our platform and are not official government or CEFR qualifications.
terms.s4Body: Paid plans are shown for preview. Billing is not yet enabled. When billing becomes available, applicable terms and prices will be presented before any charge.
terms.s5Body: We may update these terms as the platform evolves. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

about.title: About NederStart
about.intro: NederStart is a modern, affordable platform for learning Dutch — from your very first word (A0) to confident conversation (B2).
about.missionBody: We believe learning Dutch should be structured, practical and built around real life — the supermarket, the gemeente, work and everyday conversation. Native audio is always the authoritative reference, supported by optional beginner aids that fade as you progress.
about.makerBody: NederStart is designed and built by Henrique Digital Solutions, combining thoughtful language pedagogy with modern technology.
